projects.title: Data Cleaning in SQL
projects.synopsis: A gritty procedural about messy real-estate records. Standardized dates, split addresses, removed duplicates, and imputed missing values on Nashville housing data using SQL Server — turning chaos into a clean, query-ready dataset.

projects.title: Data Exploration in SQL
projects.synopsis: A global outbreak, examined one query at a time. Explored COVID-19 case and death data with SQL — window functions, CTEs, and aggregate views — to surface trends across countries and time.

projects.title: COVID-19 Data Visualization
projects.synopsis: The pandemic, visualized. An interactive Tableau dashboard tracking global infection and mortality trends — built for at-a-glance clarity during a very unclear time.
